direction.camera: Guide attention with real interface; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: one real interface proof occupies a large readable panel; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with clean hierarchy; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with focused cursor.

direction.materials: soft white panels and thin separators; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around readable proof; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use real interface,clean hierarchy,calm workspace,benefit headline,readable proof,focused cursor as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
